name: Greenfield Discovery
description: Pre-implementation discovery report for greenfield engagements. Engine fills cover + numeric/contextual fields (project description, timeline, budget sensitivity, compliance, totals). AI writes the substantive narrative for target capabilities, architecture style, technology choices, phasing, risks, and recommendations — replacing the previous raw `{{risks_list}}` and `{{recommendations_list}}` engine-bullet dumps.

sections.title: Target capabilities
sections.purpose: 4–6 markdown bullets enumerating the capability set the target system must support, derived from the project context and the engagement's recommendations. Examples: 'Multi-tenant tenancy with per-tenant data isolation', 'Real-time event ingestion with sub-second latency tier'. Each bullet a concise capability + one phrase on why it matters.

sections.title: Recommended architecture style
sections.purpose: 3–5 sentences proposing a target architecture STYLE (not a detailed design) sized to the goals, constraints, and team shape. Examples: 'event-driven microservices', 'modular monolith with extraction points', 'serverless-first with selective long-running compute'. Justify briefly. Cite the dominant constraints (timeline, budget, compliance, team) that pushed the choice.

sections.title: Technology choices
sections.purpose: 5–8 markdown bullets recommending concrete technology selections shaped by the industry, compliance posture, and delivery timeline. Each bullet: the layer (e.g. 'database', 'orchestration', 'observability') and the recommended choice + one phrase on the trade-off. Mark anything aspirational as such.

sections.title: Phasing
sections.purpose: 3–4 phases sized to the budget envelope + timeline. For each phase: short name, one-sentence goal, the 2–3 capabilities it lands, and the milestone that signals 'done'. Markdown — phase names as bold/uppercase opener, then narrative beneath.

sections.title: Discovery risks
sections.purpose: 4–6 markdown bullets covering the risks specific to a greenfield build — unknowns, assumption-driven design choices, scaling cliffs, vendor lock-in concerns. Each bullet: the risk + one phrase on how to de-risk it in early phases. Replaces the previous raw risks-bulletlist dump on this slide.

sections.title: Recommendations & next steps
sections.purpose: 5–8 markdown bullets — concrete next steps coming out of discovery, sequenced for the implementation engagement. Each bullet: action verb, outcome, one phrase on who/when. Cut housekeeping items; keep the load-bearing decisions. Replaces the previous raw recommendations-bulletlist dump.
